title: USDA Strengthens Accountability by Standardizing Grant and Cooperative Agreement Requirements
text:
WASHINGTON, July 14, 2026 - The U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced it is standardizing grant and cooperative agreement requirements across all USDA agencies.

“Today’s action not only reduces government bureaucracy, it protects taxpayers and strengthens accountability,” said the Secretary.

title: Government takes control of British Steel to secure the future of the steel industry
text:
The government has today taken control of British Steel's Scunthorpe operations to secure the future of the UK steel industry and protect thousands of jobs.

The Business Secretary said: “The steel industry faced the loss of its last blast furnaces. That's why we stepped in to save British steel. Steel is the backbone of British manufacturing and we will not let it fail.”
